verdict.rationale: Benchmark transparency is a fair question for a model provider like DeepSeek, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents benchmark methodology: no eval names with settings, harnesses, prompts or reproduction details. Community comments only refer to benchmark results in passing or question how they hold up in practice, and the API docs cover integration features, not evaluation methodology.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, published benchmark claims come with enough methodology — eval names, settings, harness or prompts — that I could reproduce or at least audit them
